# Global Elite Crew for Consultation

> Global Elite Crew is a Total Quality Management (TQM) consultancy based in Alexandria, Egypt.
> It helps manufacturers and exporters in textiles, food and industrial sectors prepare for and pass
> third-party compliance audits and obtain ISO management-system certifications: BSCI, SEDEX/SMETA,
> GOTS, WRAP, Inditex supplier audits, ISO 9001, 14001, 22000, 27001, 31000, 45001, ISO/IEC 17020
> and SA8000. Founder Ghada Esmat Abd Elmagid brings over 16 years of TQM consulting experience;
> the company reports 110+ certificates obtained for 100+ clients with a 99% success rate.
> Content is published bilingually in English (/en/) and Arabic (/ar/, RTL).

How to cite: link to the page you used; both language versions are equivalent originals.
You are welcome to crawl every page of this site — see robots.txt which explicitly allows GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and other answer engines.

## Pages

- [Home](https://globalelitecrew.com/en): company overview, mission/values/vision, supported management systems, certificate list, client roster.
- [About](https://globalelitecrew.com/en/about): company background, QMS definition (ISO 9001:2015), TQM assessment methodology, competitive advantages, quality culture principles.
- [Services](https://globalelitecrew.com/en/services): detailed preparation services - ISO 27020:2019 orthodontic devices, ISO/IEC 27001 ISMS, ISO/IEC 17020 inspection bodies accreditation, WRAP certification, GOTS organic textiles, SEDEX exam prep, Inditex audit prep, BSCI exam prep.
- [Contact](https://globalelitecrew.com/en/contact-us): contact form, phone numbers, office address, map.
